entries.text:
From whence this dungeon, [type] most [adjective]? What [adjective] [hands] fashioned its fastness, what [adjective] [hands] designed its whole? Rumors hold that [creator] [type], but none know for sure. Conjecture, after all, is but one step from lies.

Regardless. This is what is known:

[time] ago [leader] led its [horde] in through the secret entrance [secret entrance], quickly conquering the [dungeon portion]. Even now its creatures despoil the [Utility.StoneDecorative] halls, and [deface] the [Utility.GeometricSymbol] inscribed above every portal, tearing up the [Utility.MetalExoticArmor] mosaics depicting [Utility.CreatureSymbol].

It thinks itself the master of this [type2], but unbeknownst to it the [Secret Society Title.Title] of [Creepy Fantasy Villain.Scary] has resided on a secret [number] level to the [Compass direction.8] for the last [time2]. Driven into hiding there [failure], it has licked its wounds and passed the crumbling hours plotting its revenge, and over time come to think of the entirety of the dungeon as its demesne.

Direct conflict draws nigh.
